summary: No externally authored model that is CC0 (or equally permissive), downloadable without login/payment, realistic, and fits the actual kitchen slots was found for the lower cabinet run, the upper cabinet, the sink or the tap. BlenderKit lists CC0-labelled realistic taps and one kitchen composition, but every one is isFree=false (paid plan + login); none was downloaded, measured or hashed. Procedural/Blender kitchen parts stay; nothing is hidden.

lower_run.hinge: left (-x) edge of each door, pivot (center-0.325, 0.44, -3.192), open angle -0.49*pi

interaction_requirements: Lower run replacement must provide 4 separately addressable door meshes, each 0.65x0.76 m (+/- a few mm), pivotable about its own left vertical edge at the hinge positions above, or the four-door interaction/persistence (settings.lowerCabinets[4]) and sweep-collision check break.
A single fused mesh, or doors merged into a carcass, cannot replace the interactive run; at most it could replace the static carcass behind the existing interactive doors.
Upper run replacement must keep 4 door nodes consumable by attachUpperCabinetDoors (settings.cabinets[4]).
Sink replacement must fit the 0.64x0.43 opening and keep the drain at bowl center; tap must stay under the strip light (y < 1.66) and reach the bowl.
ue_conversion: UE cm = (x, z, y) * 100 from source metres; UE yaw = -source yaw. Not applied: no candidate acquired.
